description: NaVP₂O₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.83 Å. V is bonded to six O atoms to form VO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 2.01-2.12 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent VO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 22-51°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.51-1.63 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent VO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 33-54°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.63 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one V, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one V, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one V, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one V and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one V, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one V, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two P atoms.
